name: STAT 4835
title: Causal Inference
description: Introduction to causal inference, the science of drawing conclusions about cause-and-effect relationships from data. Topics include potential outcomes, randomized trials, causal graphical models, observational studies, instrumental variables, mediation and interference.
requirement_description: STAT 3445 or instructor consent. Recommend Preparation: Experience with R. Not open for credit to students who have passed STAT 5095 when offered as "Casual Inference."
